feeds.title: Global Trade Magazine » Import Export
feeds.description: Global Trade is the magazine for U.S. companies doing business globally. It educates and entertains readers on ways to utilize the global marketplace to increase market share and corporate profits, through creative efficiencies in cargo transportation, banking, joint ventures, outsourcing, and expansion opportunities. Read the latest blog posts and articles about imports and exports on the website that will give you information from all around the world to keep you updated with the happenings of the industry and improve your knowledge.

feeds.title: Import Export License
feeds.description: For assistance with getting goods in and out of South Africa timeously and cost-effectively. Import Export Licenses assist both first-time and experienced importers and exporters. Import-export ventures are highly lucrative if you know your stuff. Our import-export blog consists of guides and articles containing essential information for starting out in the import-export world, as well as handy summaries and clarifications the seasoned trader can refer to as needed.

feeds.title: Export Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Export Solutions, Inc. is your 'In-House' trade compliance team - providing solutions to cover a full range of compliance activities. Our hands-on approach will take your compliance program from good to great as we take action on everything from large-scale, major operations, and even subtle tweaks with day-to-day activities.

feeds.title: Import Export Federation Blog
feeds.description: We are experts in a variety of sectors in import-export. Import Export Federation caters to food sections that include the most demanded export products in India. These include- Spices, Vegetables, Fruits, Packaged Food, Processed Food, etc. We are best known for training to export these products & offer throughout hand-holding. Learn import and export through our blogs and stay updated about the latest trends & news in the import-export industry.

feeds.title: Noatum Logistics » Export Import
feeds.description: Noatum Logistics is a leading supply chain management company with global coverage, specializing in freight management, international supply chain management, contract logistics, project logistics, solutions, and customs and clearance. We offer specific, integrated, complex, and value-added solutions for our clients' supply chains. In our Export-Import blogs read the latest news and updates on the import-export business and get all the important details about international business.

feeds.title: Food Export Association Blog
feeds.description: We are Food Export-Midwest and Food Export-Northeast, non-profit organizations made up of agricultural promotion agencies. We exist to provide the support U.S. companies need to enter international markets by offering export education, global connections, export strategies, and marketing financial assistance. In order to help as many people as possible and, help to find answers to all important questions related to starting and growing your own import-export business, we have created this site and our business training programs.

feeds.title: EXIM Blog
feeds.description: The Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM Bank) is the official export credit agency of the United States. Its mission is to help finance exports of U.S. goods and services primarily to emerging markets to help create and sustain U.S. export-related jobs. EXIM Bank provides loan guarantees, export credit insurance, and direct loans to businesses of all sizes. No transaction is too large or too small.

feeds.title: iiiEM Blog
feeds.description: The International Institute of Import and Export Management is the leading training institute offering Integrated Entrepreneurship Programs of Import/Export and International Marketing. iiiEM has played a key role as a catalyst for new ideas, concepts, and skills for the internationalization of the Indian Economy as India is churning most of its revenue through Import and Export for having the potential of a wide range of products of its origin.

feeds.title: ShippingSolutions.com Blog
feeds.description: Shipping Solutions software helps you create your international shipping paperwork quickly and easily while staying compliant with U.S. export regulations. The blog is written by import-export professionals with in-depth knowledge and experience in these areas and the topics cover Automated Export Systems, Dangerous Goods/Hazmat, Export Basics, Export Compliance, Export Finance, and many more.

feeds.title: Import Export Experts Blog
feeds.description: Import Export Experts focuses on building long-term, sustainable business relationships with our clients and service providers. We provide a specific import & export strategy, which is tailored to your company and its specific product and service needs. Here at Import Export Experts, we are focused on building long-term, sustainable business relationships with our clients and service providers.

feeds.title: Export Boot Camps Blog
feeds.description: Exportbootcamps.com is passionate about harnessing the power of leadership to transform people and businesses for the better, in the UK and internationally. Export BootCamps are specifically designed to help busy people to glean a working knowledge of a topic, at a high level in most cases, which enables a process of working towards knowing what you don't know.

feeds.title: Exportimportpractical Blog
feeds.description: At Exportimportpractical our goal is to help and encourage people around the world to start and grow their own international businesses (export-import businesses). No matter where they from or what is their current business experience or current situation in their own business. Explore the blogs to learn about import export business with the help of blog posts, training, tips, case studies, articles, strategies, and education by European export import entrepreneurs.

feeds.title: GFE Business Blog
feeds.description: The prime aim of Impexperts is to equip students, working professionals, businessmen& future entrepreneurs with practical knowledge of Import Export & International Trade. It is our constant endeavor to provide practical and relevant knowledge by way of new to the industry modules of training & Lifetime Support through our dedicated Helpdesk, to people who are interested in making their career in the highly rewarding field of Import Export and allied services.

feeds.title: BorderBuddy Blog
feeds.description: BorderBuddy was founded a decade ago by Graham Robins. Graham's concept for BorderBuddy was to simplify the customs process. BorderBuddy specializes in importing and exporting products to North America. With a dedicated focus on consumers and small businesses, BorderBuddy keeps information focused and easy for everyone to understand. Read the blogs to get the most up-to-date news on the changing customs industry.
